# cloudsmith_repository_privileges (Data Source)

The `cloudsmith_repository_privileges` data source allows you to retrieve information about repository privileges, including service accounts, teams, and users, for a specific repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Cloudsmith Ltd 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

provider "cloudsmith" {
  api_key = "my-api-key"
}

resource "cloudsmith_repository" "test" {
  name      = "terraform-acc-test-privileges"
  namespace = "<your-namespace>"
}

data "cloudsmith_repository_privileges" "test_data" {
  organization = cloudsmith_repository.test.namespace
  repository   = cloudsmith_repository.test.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization to which this repository belongs.
- `repository` (String) Repository to fetch privileges information.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `service` (Set of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service))
- `team` (Set of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--team))
- `user` (Set of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user))
